title: The Garment of Light or Darkness Worn by the Departing Soul
description: Grounded in the cosmogonic descent: the First Man's Living Fire received a wound, the four further garments (wind, water, light, air) served as helpers, the air was stripped naked and its garment given to another. From this primal exchange comes the rule that every kingdom acts from one single principle, so what agrees with Light is exalted in the garment of life-light and what agrees with Darkness perishes under the hand of the opposing kingdom.
